title: Armor Side Story: Samurai Troopers
originalTitle: 鎧外伝　サムライトルーパー
summary: A must-read side-story collection explaining how the five obtained their armors. Rekka appeared in the Encyclopedia, Tenku in OUT's Complete Volume, Suiko in Monthly OUT, while Korin and Kongo were newly written. The reviewer calls it essential and notes that part of it was later recorded as the 'Yoroi Densho' cassette bonus and Blu-ray audio extra.
